_note: ElevenLabs narration. The build workflow reads this file, generates every clip in foundation/narration-scripts.js with this voice, keeps the raw files in assets/audio/foundation/source, and rebuilds the course audio and videos. Change voice_id, model_id or voice_settings and push to re-record; only clips whose text or settings changed are regenerated. Pushing any change to this file re-runs the build. Model eleven_v3 for natural pacing and emphasis; v3 accepts stability 0.0 (creative), 0.5 (natural) or 1.0 (robust) only.
